intent.title: Detect and contain signalling storms on the AMF
intent.description: Registration floods overwhelm the AMF and lock legitimate users out. The model must separate a storm through an unauthorised base station from a legitimate surge through our own cells, and from related RAN and user-plane attacks, then hand the remediation to the operator together with the reporting duties it triggers.

reference_points.3: ML sandbox subsystem ↔ ML pipeline subsystem: trained model handed over at deployment
reference_points.5: management subsystem (MLFO) ↔ ML pipeline subsystem: instantiation, model updates
reference_points.6: management subsystem (MLFO) ↔ ML sandbox subsystem: training, evaluation, selection
reference_points.7: MLFO ↔ other management functions: the incident-response engine (ir/engine.py) and its human gates
